# Hamsa Chembakath - LLM Profile

Hamsa Chembakath is a Senior App Architect and Full-Stack Developer specializing in modern React ecosystems, including Next.js and TanStack Start. He focuses on building highly scalable SaaS architectures, technical SEO, and data-driven digital growth.

## Core Tech Stack
- Frontend: React 19, Next.js, TanStack Start, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion
- State & APIs: TanStack Query, ORPC, tRPC
- Backend: Node.js, Prisma ORM, Better Auth, PostgreSQL
- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS

## Key Projects
- Skoohub: A comprehensive School Management System built from the ground up using TanStack Start and oRPC. Features scalable multi-tenant architecture and robust RBAC. Role: Founder & Lead Architect.
- CPL Arena: Official hub for Cheruputhoor Premier League Sevens Football. A comprehensive football tournament management app to track live scores, standings, top scorers, and full squad rosters. Role: Full-Stack Developer.
- The Canadian Home: A comprehensive property marketplace handling thousands of listings, optimized with Next.js and ISR for peak performance. Role: Senior Frontend Engineer.
- AgentRoof: All-in-one Real Estate CRM helping REALTORS® grow their business. Role: Lead Frontend Engineer.
